snippet.textDisplay: For those who don't know this about acting, it's simple-she actually most likely did have hurt feelings. For example, when crying, one technique is to actually remember something painful and work it up into tears, then focus on the subject for the scene. "Getting into character" involves actually trying to feel and think certain ways to create realistic looking behavior. So most actors, most of the time, actually experience real feelings, just their source is not the stage but some real life past experience or thoughts.

Damn good actress. She bonded with Hermione and she wanted her story to be fleshed out and progressed. That's why she feels it was the most difficult.
